description: Epi2Diff (Episode to Difficulty) converts model-generated reasoning traces into sentence-level episode sequences and extracts compact features capturing reasoning effort.
title: Epi2Diff framework: episode-induced process representations combined with semantic embeddings for item difficulty prediction

description: Epistemic network analysis (ENA) is a non-parametric analytic method developed for epistemic game data; the article focuses on its social-network based variant.
title: Epistemic network analysis (ENA)

description: Epistemological Move Analysis is an analytical approach that analyzes a teacher's role in students' learning process, used in this study to examine how the teacher directed children's learning.
title: Epistemological Move Analysis (EMA)
